text: Resolved by the metric handle contract exposing both apply_K(v) and quadform_Kinv(a). Precision-family metrics can retain their covariance and evaluate a^T K^-1 a with zero factorization; diagonal metrics use reciprocal diagonals; the exact Cholesky-solve fallback factorizes once. Product-oracle tests show the retained-covariance and solve routes agree, and diagnostics prove which route executed.
